title: Lapsus — Two-player scoreboard
description: A two-player Lapsus scoreboard. Keep score, switch roles, and make every minute count.
introCopy: Two players, a little imagination, and one minute on the clock.
timerFootnote: One minute to build. All the time you need to guess.
renameHint: Tap a name to make it yours
scoreIncorrect: Wrong guess? No points this round.
ruleBuildBody: The Speaker gets 8 syllable cards and a secret topic. Start the minute and build a word without speaking. Overlap and rearrange cards as you like.
ruleGuessBody: When time is up, stop building. Mix the secret topic with 2 other topic cards. The Translator chooses from all 3, with no time limit.
ruleScoreBody: A correct guess earns the Translator 1 point. Otherwise, no points. Switch roles each round. Agree on an even number of rounds; settle ties with extra rounds in pairs.
footerTagline: A few words. A lot of meaning.
footerNote: Made for your side of the table.
speaker: Speaker
speakerHint: Build the word. Score locked this round.
translatorHint: Find the topic. Edit your score.
buildingHint: {speaker} builds a word. No spoken hints!
guessingHint: {translator}, choose from the 3 topic cards. There is no time limit.

running: Let the syllables do the talking.

announcements.finished: Time is up. Stop building the word. {translator} can now choose a topic, with no time limit.
announcements.started: The one-minute timer has started. {speaker} is the Speaker.
announcements.reset: Timer reset to one minute. Scores have not changed.
announcements.nextRound: Round {round}. {speaker} is the Speaker. {translator} is the Translator. Timer reset; scores are unchanged.
